title: byobot cloud protocol, v1
description: The byobot logbook through a folder in the person's own cloud storage. Under <folder>/<store_id>/: epochs/<epoch>.json, devices/<device_id>.json, keys/<epoch>/<device_id or recovery>.key, segments/<device_id>/<epoch>-<seq>.seg, checkpoints/<epoch>/<part>.seg and plan/<epoch>-<seq>.seg. Epochs are four digits, seqs and parts ten. No file is changed after it is written. Keys and signatures are base64. Segment messages are the same messages as sync.schema.json.

header.description: A segment's first line, JSON and plain; the associated data of its ciphertext. Then the ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext of the gzipped body under the epoch key, then the writer's Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over 'byobot-cloud segment 1\n', the header line and the ciphertext.

device_id.description: The writer. Checkpoints and plans are the keeper's.

seq.description: Grows per device across epochs; a checkpoint's part number.

message.description: One line of a segment's body. A relay writes events and samples; the keeper writes events, a checkpoint's events, and a plan with its receipts. A relay reading a plan leaves out a message it doesn't know; the keeper keeps a segment holding one unread until it is upgraded.

receipts.description: Beside the plan: each relay's segments in the plan's epoch that the keeper has read, by seq, and the samples messages in them it refused, by line. A relay drops what it sent only once its segment is here; a segment gone from the folder and not here is sent again.

end.description: A segment body's last line: how many lines came before it, so a cut file is found.

class.description: The keeper holds the full store; a relay sends what it logged and reads the plan.

box.description: X25519 public key that epoch keys are sealed to.

sign.description: Ed25519 public key its files are signed with.

device_file.description: devices/<device_id>.json, plain. A relay's join request carries the proof: base64 HMAC-SHA256, keyed by the join secret, of 'byobot-cloud join 1', store_id, device_id, box and sign joined by newlines.

signed.description: A file its writer signed: the exact body bytes, and the Ed25519 signature over 'byobot-cloud document 1\n' and them. Epoch and key files are the keeper's.

epoch_body.description: epochs/<epoch>.json's body. Written last when an epoch starts; the highest one a device can verify is current.

devices.description: The devices the epoch started with.

checkpoint.description: How many checkpoint parts hold the logbook as the epoch started.

closed.description: The keeper closed the folder (`cloud off --delete yes`): every other file is deleted, and any keeper may start again past this epoch. Readers that don't know it see an epoch that lists only the keeper.

key_body.description: keys/<epoch>/<device_id>.key's body: the epoch key sealed to one device, which the keeper's signature admits. Sealing: an ephemeral X25519 key, HKDF-SHA256 of the shared secret (salt: ephemeral then recipient public key, info 'byobot-cloud seal 1'), ChaCha20-Poly1305 with a zero nonce and associated data 'byobot-cloud key 1', store_id, epoch and device_id joined by newlines.

recovery_file.description: keys/<epoch>/recovery.key, plain. The recovery code is 32 base32 characters (20 bytes); its key is HKDF-SHA256 of those bytes, salt store_id, info 'byobot-cloud recovery 1'. The ciphertext holds the epoch key, the store key and the keeper's keys; its associated data is 'byobot-cloud recovery 1', store_id and epoch joined by newlines.
